top_signals.title: Brave browser adds email aliases to help users evade tracking
top_signals.summary: The latest version of the Brave browser, 1.94, introduces a feature called 'Email Aliases' that allows users to generate disposable email addresses when signing up to a new service. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
